function.name: ranking_at_coordinate_point_for_local_rank_tracker
function.description: This is the subfunction for tool "local_rank_tracker", you can use this tool.The description of this function is: "Get search results at the specified coordinate point and additional ranking data for the business with `place_id`."

place_id.description: The Google Place ID of the business to match against in results.

function.name: full_grid_search_for_local_rank_tracker
function.description: This is the subfunction for tool "local_rank_tracker", you can use this tool.The description of this function is: "Make a full grid search and get the ranking of a specific business in every coordinate point in the grid. The grid cells / entires in the results are ordered left-to-right then top-down."

radius.description:
The distance between coordinate points (on the same row / column in the grid). The units of the radius are determined by the **distance_units** parameter.

**Allowed values:** 0.1-100.
**Default:** 1

lat.description: Grid center coordinate point latitude value.

grid_size.description:
The size of the grid (i.e. 3x3, 5x5, 7x7, etc).

**Allowed values:** 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13, 15.

place_id.description: The Google Place ID of the business to match against in results.

lng.description: Grid center coordinate point longitude value.

zoom.description:
Google Maps zoom level to use for search on each grid point.

**Allowed values:** 0-18.
**Default:** 13.

radius_units.description:
Distance measurement units to use for the radius parameter (kilometers / miles).

**Allowed values:** km, mi.
**Default:** km.

function.name: search_business_locations_for_local_rank_tracker
function.description: This is the subfunction for tool "local_rank_tracker", you can use this tool.The description of this function is: "Returns a list of found Google My Business locations based on search query, including Service Area Businesses (SAB)."

near.description: Narrow down your search results by using a city, state, country or any other free-form location string (e.g. *california, usa*).

function.name: calculate_grid_coordinate_points_for_local_rank_tracker
function.description: This is the subfunction for tool "local_rank_tracker", you can use this tool.The description of this function is: "Get all grid coordinate points based on a center geocoordinate point and distance arguments."

radius.description:
The distance between coordinate points (on the same row / column in the grid). The units of the radius are determined by the **distance_units** parameter.

**Allowed values:** 0.1-100.
**Default:** 1

lng.description: Grid center coordinate point longitude value.

grid_size.description:
The size of the grid (i.e. 3x3, 5x5, 7x7, etc).

**Allowed values:** 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13, 15.

lat.description: Grid center coordinate point latitude value.

radius_units.description:

**Allowed values:** km, mi.
**Default:** km.
